<b>Fine Pins</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
12 Fine Pins are required to complete the <i>[[Fine Pins]]</i> [[Wish]], given out by the [[Wishwalls|Wishwall]] at [[Songclave]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Jubilana 01.png!Location in Choral Chambers
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Jubilana 01.png!Wishwall in Choral Chambers
}}

== How to Acquire ==
Fine Pins are dropped by defeated [[Choristor]]s and [[Reed]]s.

[[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] can carry up to 12 Fine Pins, after which they will no longer drop from defeated Choirbugs.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Choristor 01.png!Choristor locations in Choral Chambers
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Choristor 01.png!Choristor in Choral Chambers
}}
